title: Speak Page Actions
user: People with limited vision or hand mobility who need to operate ordinary browser pages by speaking a small, reviewable set of visible actions.
smallest_useful_product: A Chromium extension that enumerates visible, labelled buttons/links/form fields, supports offline grammar for click label, then shows a confirmation for destructive actions.
constraints: Local speech recognition where browser or OS permits; push-to-talk only; never read masked fields; confirmation and undo for submits or deletes; respect site CSP and permissions.
